definitions.gradient: Last training-step parameter gradient, not a dense probe mean; stale skipped branches omitted.
definitions.update: Actual current parameter minus snapshot, including momentum and direct shrinkage; not lr*gradient.
definitions.relative_update: L2 update divided by snapshot parameter L2; null for zero denominator.
definitions.reduction: FP32 mean/L2 reductions; scalar transfer packed once. Nonfinite scalar outputs are null.

update_interval.meaning: Net displacement between telemetry checkpoints, not one optimizer step

definitions.activation_input: A: input to affine layer; mean_activation/msr_activation and a_sparsity refer to A.
definitions.backprop_preactivation: B=d(sum probe CE)/d(affine output), unaveraged per-example derivative; mean_backprop/msr_backprop use B.
definitions.zero_vs_nonpositive: zero_fraction counts exact0; a_sparsity/b_sparsity count <=0. They are different for signed inputs/derivatives.
definitions.dead_units: all_zero_units_on_probe_fraction is inactivity on this finite probe, not permanent neuron death.
definitions.grad_l2: L2/Frobenius norm of mean per-example WEIGHT gradient B.T@A/n; bias gradients separate. grad_fro is the same explicit legacy alias.
definitions.gradient_noise: E||g_i||² - ||E g_i||², weight-only, population moment; no Hessian or covariance materialized. Tiny negative values from FP32 cancellation are retained.
definitions.neighbor_cosine: Cyclic adjacent fixed-probe weight gradients, factored inner product; zero-gradient pairs excluded; not IID gradient-noise inference.
definitions.median: Interpolated .5 quantile of per-example weight-gradient L2 norms.
definitions.mode: Manual dense eval operator, no SD/unit dropout; model flags, RNG and persistent parameter.grad buffers untouched.

telemetry.probe_definition: First fixed training-pool examples, raw pixel+label hash; dense eval semantics, no sampled masks or unit dropout
telemetry.time_definition: GPU-synchronized epoch training excludes evaluation, telemetry and checkpoint I/O; run elapsed includes them; upload later
telemetry.metrics_definition: Corrected modern statistics retain explicit namespaces; no historical bugs or expensive Hessian callbacks in training
